content.title: "Magic" Fuels Hasbro's Momentum
content.description: "Magic: The Gathering" is powering Hasbro into the holiday season.  The 30-year-old card game has become the company's breakout growth engine. But Morgan Stanley Analyst Megan Clapp says the market still isn't fully pricing in how Hasbro's shift toward games and IP is reshaping the story heading into 2026. She joined Bloomberg Open Interest with her outlook.

content.title: Wizards -- The 'Magic' Behind Hasbro's Return to Growth
content.description: With traditional toy and game sales lagging, Hasbro has found a growth engine in roleplaying games such as Dungeons and Dragons, trading card games like Magic: The Gathering, and a growing portfolio of digital and video games. On Bloomberg Chief Future Officer, Hasbro CFO/COO Gina Goetter tells Matt Miller how the company's Wizards of the Coast segment is poised to generate an increasing share of annual revenue.

content.title: How Hasbro's Meeting the Tariff Challenge
content.description: Tariffs on imports from China have hit US toy and game companies hard, with Hasbro estimating a $60M impact on net profit in 2025. On Bloomberg Chief Future Officer, CFO/COO Gina Goetter tells Matt Miller how the company has been diversifying its manufacturing base to counteract these headwinds.
